marketing.about.a_feature_should_remove_real_friction_cl: A feature should remove real friction, clarify a decision or make data more reliable.
marketing.about.a_product_foundation_not_an_exaggerated_: A product foundation, not an exaggerated promise
marketing.about.every_entry_should_explain_work_decision: Every entry should explain work, decisions and growth, not only confirm attendance.
marketing.about.forms_charts_modals_and_filters_are_desi: Forms, charts, modals and filters are designed for mobile, tablet and desktop instead of patched later.
marketing.about.internship_information_is_often_scattere: Internship information is often scattered across timesheets, school documents, personal notes, screenshots and memories. This fragmentation makes progress hard to see and reports difficult to prepare.
marketing.about.local_mode_works_without_an_account_expo: Local mode works without an account, exports stay available and cloud sync remains optional.
marketing.about.make_internships_measurable_presentable_: Make internships measurable, presentable and genuinely educational.
marketing.about.practicora_brings_these_elements_into_a_: Practicora brings these elements into a calm, structured workspace. The goal is not to add administration, but to turn a few minutes of regular documentation into a reliable professional history.
marketing.about.practicora_is_first_designed_for_student: Practicora is first designed for students and interns who want reliable data, clearer progress and better reports. The same structure can later support supervisor meetings, program assessments and portfolio preparation.
marketing.about.practicora_is_the_working_name_used_for_: Practicora is the working name used for this new version. Before public commercialization, the name, trademarks and domains must undergo complete legal and commercial clearance.
marketing.about.practicora_starts_from_a_simple_idea_a_s: Practicora starts from a simple idea: a student should not have to reconstruct months of work when writing a report or preparing for an interview.
marketing.about.the_current_version_is_a_functional_saas: The current version is a functional SaaS foundation: indexable public site, private app, local data, Supabase integration, authentication, exports, responsive design and analytics. Future institutional features must be validated with real programs before being presented as available.
marketing.about.the_student_remains_central_while_the_st: The student remains central, while the structure also supports reports, supervisor discussions and future institutional needs.
marketing.about.transitions_remain_short_and_subtle_they: Transitions remain short and subtle. They communicate state changes without slowing work.

marketing.faq.metadata_description: Clear answers about internship journals, reports, institutions, privacy and account setup.
marketing.faq.title: Answers without the runaround
marketing.faq.description: Search by topic and open only the questions you need.
marketing.faq.contact_description: Tell us what you are trying to accomplish and we will route the request to the right place.
marketing.faq.q1_question: Can Practicora work before cloud setup?
marketing.faq.q1_answer: Yes. Local-first mode stores your workspace in the browser. Cloud synchronization can be enabled later without blocking initial use.
marketing.faq.q2_question: What belongs in a professional internship entry?
marketing.faq.q2_answer: Record hours, context, completed work, learning, blockers, feedback, next steps and authorized evidence. Practicora keeps the form structured without forcing every field.
marketing.faq.q3_question: How do I avoid producing a 100-page report?
marketing.faq.q3_answer: Choose a concise, standard or complete detail level, then filter the period and sections. Metrics can cover the whole period while the detailed journal is intentionally limited.
marketing.faq.q4_answer: Only a Platform Director with the global permission can create an institutional workspace. Institution administrators can then invite their own members according to assigned roles.
marketing.faq.q5_answer: No. Necessary storage supports core functions. Preferences, analytics and marketing choices remain optional and can be changed later.
marketing.faq.q6_question: Why are social sign-in cards visible before setup?
marketing.faq.q6_answer: Visibility helps teams understand the intended options. Unconfigured providers remain disabled and clearly display the required configuration instead of failing silently.
marketing.faq.q7_answer: Practicora supports structured JSON backups and CSV exports. Reports can also be printed to PDF. Always follow your institution and employer confidentiality rules.
marketing.faq.q8_answer: The shell, forms, calendars, filters and tables are designed for desktop, tablet and mobile. Dense views adapt instead of simply shrinking.
marketing.faq.q9_question: Does Practicora replace an official security review?
marketing.faq.q9_answer: No. The security page documents the current direction and controls, but a public deployment still requires environment-specific testing, configuration and review.
marketing.faq.q10_answer: Use the guide for navigation questions or the contact form for account, institution, partnership or accessibility requests.
